articles.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
articles.description: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

articles.title: U.S. CPI rose stronger than expected 0.4% in October; core rate rose 0.3%
articles.description: A December rate hike appears completely assured, with Fed Governor Chris Waller suggesting even a 50-basis-point move could be appropriate.

articles.title: Bitcoin’s ‘best buying opportunity ever’ has arrived: Mark Moss
articles.description: Bitcoin Opportunity Fund co-founder Mark Moss says that with banks and ETFs widening access to Bitcoin he expects a new record high in 2027.

articles.title: Morning Minute: Vitalik Recasts ETH as a Store of Value
articles.description: It’s a big shift for Ethereum from the “ultrasound money” days. But can ETH compete as a store-of-value play?

articles.title: Bitcoin may benefit as global tightening slows, Binance Research says
articles.description: Binance Research says Bitcoin could find support as global monetary tightening slows, even as markets price in a December Fed rate hike.

articles.title: Binance Warns of Apple iOS Flaw That Could Expose iPhone Users' Private Keys
articles.description: Apple has not publicly confirmed the "worse_query" bug, which a researcher published days before its latest iOS security update.

articles.title: Ripple Prime head Marc Asch to step down, Noel Kimmel named successor
articles.description: Asch is stepping down as head of the institutional prime brokerage.

articles.title: Bitcoin breaks with stocks, declines as ETF outflows mount, MARA reduces holdings
articles.description: Your day-ahead look for Nov. 10, 2026

articles.title: Binance Halts MEXC Transfers as FinCEN Cuts Exchange Off From US Financial System
articles.description: The exchange will reject withdrawals to MEXC and hold deposits from it for review, after FinCEN tied it to $16 billion in suspicious flows.

articles.title: Coinbase, Kalshi join lawsuit backing CFTC over US stock perp futures
articles.description: Coinbase, Kalshi and four other companies backed the CFTC in a lawsuit over whether US exchanges can list perpetual futures tied to individual stocks.

articles.title: Nvidia, Jensen Huang Sued by Shareholders Over Alleged Ties to Suspected Chinese Spy
articles.description: A proposed class action claims the chipmaker misled investors about the CEO's alleged affair and the national security risks it posed.

articles.title: Binance warns iOS flaw could expose crypto wallet keys
articles.description: The exchange urged iPhone users to remove apps installed from untrusted sources, and it is unclear whether Apple’s latest iOS updates fix the flaw.

articles.title: Bitcoin lags stock rebound in advance of U.S. inflation report
articles.description: Bitcoin slipped despite a Monday rebound in U.S. stocks, with spot ETFs losing $201 million as traders await October inflation data later today.

articles.title: Ex-employee sues Ethereum Foundation and Vitalik Buterin over firing
articles.description: Kayleen Fulton alleges she was fired less than two weeks after disclosing a cancer diagnosis and helping organize a staff letter challenging a requirement to endorse the foundation’s new mandate.

articles.title: Bitcoin slips before U.S. inflation report as traders price in Fed rate increase
articles.description: Fed Governor Waller backs December tightening even if inflation cools, while falling oil prices offer some relief and Anthropic withdraws IPO pricing details.

articles.title: Live news: Bitcoin adds to losses after disappointing inflation data
articles.description: A rate hike in December appears totally assured now, with Fed Governor Chris Waller suggesting even a 50-basis-point move could be appropriate.

articles.title: 'Tough Questions' Ahead: Warren Targets Prediction Markets, Trump Crypto as Banking Chair
articles.description: An aide said Trump family crypto businesses should "preserve their documents" as Warren prepares to take over the Senate Banking Committee.

articles.title: Bitcoin price eyes $74K as Fed rate-hike bets hit 96% after Waller speech
articles.description: Bitcoin price action and stock futures trended lower after Fed governor Christopher Waller said that he would vote to raise interest rates by 0.25% at the December FOMC meeting.

articles.title: The crypto wallet that grew up inside Telegram is striking out on its own
articles.description: The app will offer crypto trading, tokenized U.S. stocks and ETFs, and perpetual futures, all already available through Telegram.

articles.title: Coinbase, Kalshi, Kraken parent back CFTC in legal fight over stock perpetual futures
articles.description: The Capital Markets Alliance argues that the products fall under the Securities and Exchange Commission’s jurisdiction.

articles.title: BitGo Q3 profit nearly doubles on crypto gains as revenue falls 51%
articles.description: BitGo’s $71 million unrealized gain on its crypto holdings helped nearly double its net income, but revenue and earnings came in below preliminary analyst expectations.

articles.title: BlackRock Bitcoin ETF outflows hit $1.66B over seven trading sessions
articles.description: US spot Bitcoin ETFs shed $201 million Monday, with seven straight sessions of net withdrawals from BlackRock’s IBIT totaling $1.66 billion.

articles.title: Securitize agrees to buy River One to expand into asset-backed lending
articles.description: Securitize agreed to buy River One to bring stablecoin funding to asset-backed lending and expects the deal to close in the fourth quarter of 2026.

articles.title: An 11-year-old Ethereum wallet moved $4.6 million and dodged a scam set up in minutes
articles.description: Bots spotted a wallet from Ethereum’s 2015 launch the moment it stirred and planted lookalike addresses in its history, but the owner sent the money to the right place anyway.

articles.title: Bitcoin miner MARA sold 13,597 BTC for $1.1 billion in six weeks, plans to sell more
articles.description: MARA paid off every loan backed by its bitcoin and says the rest of its coins can fund AI datacenters.

articles.title: Crypto exchanges need hard dollar caps on hot wallets, CertiK says
articles.description: “Cold storage is a useful measure of online exposure, but it is not a standalone security score,” the cybersecurity firm told Cointelegraph.

articles.title: XRP Ledger maps out quantum-proof accounts, with no extra fees for users
articles.description: The XRP Ledger Foundation’s design lets owners add a quantum-resistant key and switch off the old one, part of a roadmap that puts the network on track for a full transition by 2028.

articles.title: Bitcoin faces U.S. CPI test as analysts warn inflation relief may not be enough
articles.description: Bitcoin trades below $75,000 ahead of the October inflation data. Analysts warning that sustainable recovery depends on improving liquidity and spot ETF demand rather than temporary macro relief.

articles.title: OpenAI builds kill switch to stop rogue agents within 35 seconds
articles.description: Control Room cuts off model output for internal research jobs when people or automated monitors flag safety or security concerns.

articles.title: HIVE, MARA mine more Bitcoin but earn less as crypto prices fall
articles.description: Both miners reported higher Bitcoin production but lower mining revenue and rising electricity costs as they expanded their AI infrastructure businesses.

articles.title: Securitize pushes into $6 trillion asset-backed finance market with River One acquisition
articles.description: The tokenization firm unveiled an acquisition and a $50 million stock buyback as quarterly revenue rose 13%. SECZ shares jumped 10% after hours.

articles.title: Anthropic's Claude Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.0 Are Impressive, But Be Prepared to Sell a Kidney to Afford Them
articles.description: Anthropic's latest AI can build complex software and even design physical objects. Users are producing impressive results, and estimated bills large enough to make developers wince.

articles.title: AI Data Centers Are Buying Used Jet Engines as New Power Turbines Take Six Years
articles.description: A shortage of new gas turbines is pushing AI developers toward refurbished power equipment and jet-engine-based generators, even as high prices, pollution concerns, and permitting delays threaten their expansion plans.

articles.title: Should you leave Australia to avoid paying 47% tax on crypto gains?
articles.description: Some Australian crypto investors are moving overseas to avoid the huge CGT increase from July 2027. But there are also less drastic ways you can pay less tax.

articles.title: North Korean hackers create memecoins to launder funds from Binance hack: Elliptic
articles.description: The blockchain firm traced stolen funds through six new tokens on NEAR, where hackers used liquidity pools to obscure transfers between wallets.

articles.title: Google Takes Aim at Nvidia With New AI Chips Built for Privacy and Massive Memory
articles.description: Google’s TPU 8tx protects sensitive AI workloads, while the dual-chip TPU 8i Max targets memory-hungry AI agents.

articles.title: Formation Securities plans Solana stock trading venue under SEC exemption
articles.description: The proposed venue would offer 24/7 trading of tokenized shares from Galaxy Digital, Exodus and Forward Industries, with a launch planned for early 2027.

articles.title: Robinhood backs tokenization of its stock on OKX–ICE platform even as most companies opt out
articles.description: The brokerage firm said it would rather help build tokenized markets than sit on the sidelines, following a wave of early corporate pushback to the Intercontinental Exchange and OKX joint venture.

articles.title: Binance Hack Launderers Mint Elon Musk and Animal Meme Coins to Move Stolen Crypto
articles.description: Elliptic says the hackers are minting their own worthless tokens—complete with cartoon animal and Elon Musk logos—and routing stolen funds through liquidity pools to break the trail.

articles.title: Bitcoin in Limbo as Stocks Rebound Ahead of US Inflation Report
articles.description: U.S. stocks rallied as oil fell, but Bitcoin hovered near $75,000 after a wave of liquidations, with Tuesday’s inflation report set to test bets on a December Fed rate hike.

articles.title: Nvidia's $350 Billion Scare: What Happens If Jensen Huang Leaves?
articles.description: Nvidia shares slid as much as 8% amid spy allegations. The stock was already weakening, and investors now face a bigger question: Who replaces Jensen Huang if he suddenly leaves?

articles.title: Mercado Bitcoin begins post-hack reopening without a timeline for withdrawals
articles.description: Customers can view their pre-hack balances as access returns in phases. The exchange has yet to say when withdrawals will resume.

articles.title: PNC Bank tests turning USDC payments into dollar deposits
articles.description: The pilot lets eligible corporate and institutional clients accept USDC on Ethereum, with each token converted to one US dollar before deposit.

articles.title: Solana Set for Another Tokenized Stock Venue as Formation Notifies the SEC
articles.description: Operating under the SEC’s “Innovation Exemption,” the firm plans to list tokenized shares of Exodus, Forward Industries, and Galaxy Digital in early 2027, with the same voting and dividend rights as real stock.

articles.title: Avalanche’s AVAX leads crypto gains following NYSE tokenization deal
articles.description: Avalanche’s AVAX token rose as much as 10% after the NYSE selected its blockchain to support settlement on a planned tokenized stock trading platform.

articles.title: Vitalik Buterin Moves On From ‘Ultrasound Money,’ Says ETH’s Value Is Stability
articles.description: The Ethereum co-founder says ETH's value comes from stability, not fee burns, citing its decentralization, censorship resistance and security.

articles.title: Bitcoin, tech stocks brush off Nvidia nerves as analyst mulls $68K target

articles.title: Tom Lee’s Bitmine Adds $20M in Ethereum, Seizing on Vitalik’s 'ETH Is Money' Declaration
articles.description: The firm’s stash reached 6.07 million ETH—4.97% of supply and 99% of the way to its “Alchemy of 5%” goal—as chairman Tom Lee called Vitalik Buterin’s “ETH is money” comments a “seismic shift.”

articles.title: A Bitcoin block just neared a 2015 transaction record, but paid only $180 in fees

articles.title: NYSE Taps Avalanche to Settle Its Planned Tokenized Stock Platform
articles.description: Ava Labs said Avalanche will serve as the “core ledger technology” for the clearing firm behind the NYSE-affiliated venue, which aims to bring 24/7 trading, clearing and settlement of tokenized securities onchain.

articles.title: Google’s AI chip push adds more pressure on Nvidia
articles.description: Google’s specialised AI chips threaten greater competition as Nvidia faces a leadership investigation.

articles.title: North Korean hackers are creating memecoins to wash loot from $6.3 billion Binance hack

articles.title: Analysts see no broader ‘contagion’ from $6.3B Binance hack
articles.description: Binance’s pledge to cover all user losses helped contain the fallout from the $6.3 billion hack, analysts said.

articles.title: NYSE picks Avalanche to settle tokenized stocks amid Wall Street's blockchain race
articles.description: Avalanche will serve as the core settlement ledger for the exchange's planned blockchain stock market

articles.title: The $2.85B Binance hackers lost shows why the UK needs stablecoin freeze rules
articles.description: The Binance hack proved stablecoin freezes work. Now the UK should make clear freeze rules a condition of listing coins.

articles.title: Strategy buys 1,036 Bitcoin as BTC holdings climb to 850,364
articles.description: Strategy bought $81.9 million in Bitcoin last week while spending $188.3 million repurchasing STRC preferred shares, according to its latest SEC filing.

articles.title: Strategy Buys $82M in Bitcoin, Buys Back $188M of STRC

articles.title: Microsoft-Backed Space and Time Launches Platform to Let AI Agents Verify Private Data

articles.title: Solana set for its first tokenized stock venue under SEC framework, listing Galaxy
articles.description: Formation Securities plans to launch in early 2027 with Galaxy, Exodus and Forward Industries shares, expanding the U.S. regulator's experiment in blockchain-based stock trading.

articles.title: Trump says he knows ‘nothing’ about World Liberty’s UAE ties as Justin Sun challenges filings

articles.description: The exchange will move its institutional crypto custody business under federal oversight, building on its 2018 New York trust charter.

articles.title: Trump Says He Knows 'Nothing' About World Liberty Financial as He Defends UAE Ties
articles.description: Pressed on why he doesn't divest from the family's crypto venture, Trump said his sons run the business and every president faces conflicts.

articles.title: Robinhood opens access to US IPOs for UK retail investors

articles.description: The proposed reduction aims to shorten transaction confirmation times and improve the user experience for point-of-sale payments, exchange deposits and cross-chain swaps.

articles.title: Paraguay Protests Over Bank Lockout Intensify as Impeachment Vote Nears

articles.title: Bitcoin ETFs Bleed $430 Million as Tech Rout Tests Wall Street Buyers
